scope: Automatic Resume, Off in Settings and root progress, and profile availability focus/feedback. Partial Q06 evidence only.

decision.Morgan: Keep stable current-focused controls through mutation/readback with aria unavailable/busy and guarded actions, no completion focus. Share a synchronous lock across these actions, retain App-owned origin-tagged errors. Availability shows saved state plus requested direction pending. Root progress retention says on/off from saved state when a check ends.
decision.Steve: Independent proposal/challenge and final actual source review support; earlier saved-vs-requested checkbox reservation resolved by explicit pending direction. Final no blocker or reservation; did not replay native/build/lint.
decision.Elena: Independent proposal/challenge and final actual source review support; exact element state avoids render ref reads/stale owner. Final no blocker; did not rerun build/lint.

checks.build: Final npm run build including TypeScript exit0, session12742 in originating turn; no source changes afterward. Session no longer retained when queried during documentation.
checks.lint: Final npm run lint exit0, session36509 in originating turn. Initial lint found6 render ref reads, corrected before final build and all final native runs. Session no longer retained when queried during documentation.
checks.nativeInput: CUA native app at1280x720, normal app zoom1; screenshots visually inspected inline. Read-only Playwright/main/storage observation. No DOM input.
checks.predicates: Parsed all snapshots; assertions passed for baseline BODY loss, native enabled exact focused actions, pending aria state, held readback, saved availability value, preserved draft4/saved3 after Off, single persistent errors, real running/no-news/interrupted workflow states, normal Tab/blur, unchanged paused playback, zero external/HTTP writes.
checks.timedSourceExperiment: First root-progress experiment held fetch and hit normal source timeout before interaction; progress-success.json is an experiment report, not a root-Off pass. Three raw snapshots retained by hashes separately. Replaced fixture hold with cancellable pre-feed NewsService.script gate before source timeout. No production change from this experiment.
checks.availabilityAttempts: 3 actual setRoomProfileEnabled calls incl pre-operation failure, explicit retry to false, restore true.
checks.settingsAttempts: 2 workflow resume calls and2 Off calls, each incl injected pre-operation failure and explicit retry.
checks.progressAttempts: One actual Resume and one Off per progress run. Success aborts actual running workflow; failure run releases synthetic empty RSS first, persists no-news while Off remains held, then fails Off before operation and preserves on state/error after Tab.

fixture.rendererAndPreload: Production final renderer/preload. Actual copied instrumented main/storage; no production main source changed.
fixture.pausedPhase: paused-bootstrap.mjs, paused-observe.cjs and timed-source-main.js are preserved bytes for baseline/settings.
fixture.progressPhase: bootstrap.mjs and observe.cjs with out/main/index.js pre-feed cancellable gate; stopped automatic interval, explicit actual scheduler tick, synthetic empty feed only when released.
fixture.isolation: Disposable safeStorage/catalog, null shared-key adapter, placeholder local provider keys solely to exercise real readiness; all external requests blocked. No provider output or paid request stubbed as success. Muted media; paused queue unchanged.
fixture.cleanup: All owned observer apps and catalog stopped; sessions76365 and66189 exit0, catalog69885 exit143 after exact PID31542 command verification.
